name: snowtime
title: Snowtime
description: Start and stop your Snowtime timer.
author: kustav_prants

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Instance URL
preferences.description: The address of your Snowtime, such as https://snowtime.snowhound.eu.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: A personal API key. Create one in Snowtime under Settings → API keys: a read key shows your entries and timer, a write key also starts and stops timers.

preferences.name: suggestionRange
preferences.title: Suggestions From
preferences.description: How far back Start Timer looks for entries to suggest.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
